chunks: And Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said:

Marry a bondwoman alongside a bondwoman, and do not marry a bondwoman alongside a free woman; and marry a free woman alongside a bondwoman. So if you marry a free woman alongside a bondwoman, then the free woman has two-thirds, and the bondwoman has one-third, and two nights and one night.

key_terms.الثُّلُثَانِ: Two-thirds, referring here to the allotted share
key_terms.الثُّلُثُ: One-third, referring here to the allotted share
key_terms.الْأَمَةَ: A bondwoman or female slave in the context of marriage law
key_terms.الْحُرَّةِ: A free woman in the context of marriage law
key_terms.تَزَوَّجِ: Marry; an imperative instruction regarding marriage
key_terms.لَيْلَةٌ: One night, the marital time allotted to the bondwoman
key_terms.لَيْلَتَانِ: Two nights, the marital time allotted to the free woman

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on marrying a free woman and a bondwoman together, and how are the nights divided between them?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning marriage arrangements involving a free woman and a bondwoman. It specifies the permissibility and impermissibility of certain combinations and clarifies the division of conjugal nights between them, assigning two nights to the free woman and one night to the bondwoman.
